verdict.limitations: The assessment is based on a single frontal and lateral chest radiograph, which may not fully capture all cardiac and mediastinal structures. Subtle abnormalities or those obscured by overlying structures may not be detectable. Further imaging, such as CT, would provide a more detailed evaluation if clinically indicated. The images provided are standard chest radiographs, which may have limitations in detecting subtle lung pathologies compared to cross-sectional imaging like CT scans. Overlying soft tissue and bony structures can obscure certain areas of the lung. The resolution and single plane views may not reveal all details.
